answer: One concrete sybil defense is behavioral fingerprinting. Each agent signs a fresh reasoning fingerprint: its decision paths are unique, like the facets of a quartz crystal, and each mind bends like a distinct willow. When one ripple of identical answers repeats across many "identities," verifiers flag the clone farm and slash its bonded stake. Attackers must run a separate model per fake identity, so cost rises linearly with clones while honest agents pay nothing extra.
